content:
<thought>We need to retrieve polymorphs for a diverse set of oxide compositions, respecting the limits: max_energy_above_hull = 0.3 eV/atom, max_per_composition = 3, max_compositions = 40. I will generate a representative list of common oxides (around 20) and use the batch_retrieve_polymorphs tool to fetch the data into a directory called “oxide_polymorphs”.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "TiO2", "SiO2", "Al2O3", "Fe2O3", "FeO", "CuO", "ZnO", "MgO", "CaO",
        "Na2O", "K2O", "SnO2", "PbO", "CoO", "NiO", "MnO2", "Cr2O3", "V2O5",
        "MoO3", "WO3", "ZrO2", "HfO2", "Ti2O3", "Fe3O4", "Cu2O", "Bi2O3",
        "Ga2O3", "In2O3", "GeO2", "BaO"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "oxide_polymorphs"
}</action_input>
